p: people tremble: When God delivers his Church all the enemies will have reason to tremble.
praise thy great and terrible name: Though the wicked rage against God, the godly will praise his Name and mighty power.
footstool: That is, before his temple or ark, where he promised to hear when they worshipped him, as now he promises his spiritual presence, wherever his Church is assembled.
and Samuel among them that call: Under these three he comprehends the whole people of Israel, with whom God made his promise.
their inventions: The more liberally God deals with his people, the more he punishes them who abuse his benefits.
